summary: Shaded north kerb on Heroes Avenue beside a gravel lot and trees.
reasons: Backs onto trees and gravel car park
Cars already stop on this kerb

drivers.seclusion: Trees and a gravel club car park behind the kerb; only sheds within 14-48 m and homes 42 m or more beyond the end.
drivers.access_and_room: Two cars sit at the north road edge here, so there is room beside the lane; the gravel lot is also reachable nearby.
drivers.traffic: Through road near a signalled junction; moderate traffic and some noise.
drivers.convention: A white and a dark car stand on this edge in the imagery; a caravan is parked in the lot to the north-east.

flags: Low-lying: about 2 m elevation, Toowong Creek 102 m away
Slope rises to about 14% past 70 m, outside the best section
Junction noise at the east end
sun_shade: Large trees shade the kerb from the north and west; open to midday sun from the road side.
cannot_judge: Parking signs or time limits on site
Whether the parked cars stay overnight

best_section.where: North kerb opposite the baseball park, beside the trees and gravel lot
